name: Assassin's Dagger
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 150, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 471
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 150, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 471
Aura moderate necromancy CL 9th
Slot none; Price 10,302 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
This wicked-looking, curved +2 dagger provides a +1 bonus to the DC of a Fortitude save forced by the death attack of an assassin.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, slay living; Price 5,302 gp
